_about: The platform figures Lesson 01 teaches from. Every entry carries its figure, its source, and its limits, because an unsourced number is this course's definition of a bug. Checked 2026-11-07.

awesome_claude_code_stars.limits: Stars measure attention and ecosystem size, not anyone's earnings
awesome_claude_code_stars.source: GitHub star count for hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code, checked via third-party API reporting in October 2026

complex_ai_work_earnings.limits: Reported second-hand; describes freelancers doing complex AI-assisted work on one platform, not individuals' guarantees
complex_ai_work_earnings.source: Upwork Future Workforce Index, as reported in secondary coverage checked 2026-11-07

datacamp_beginner_course_learners.limits: One platform's beginner course; enrolment is attention, not income
datacamp_beginner_course_learners.source: DataCamp course index for Claude Code 101, ratings and learner counts verified there 2026-09-24

fiverr_claude_code_searches.figure: +938% in searches for Claude Code specialists, November 2025 to April 2026 versus the prior six months
fiverr_claude_code_searches.limits: Search interest, not completed purchases; reported, not independently verified for this course
fiverr_claude_code_searches.source: Fiverr data as reported in secondary coverage checked 2026-11-07

simple_genai_work_per_contract.figure: about -13% per contract, while contract starts rose about +90%
simple_genai_work_per_contract.limits: Reported second-hand; the pattern (volume up, price down) is the teaching point, not the decimals
simple_genai_work_per_contract.source: Upwork Future Workforce Index, as reported in secondary coverage checked 2026-11-07

upwork_ai_chatbot_growth.limits: Same basis and caveat as the integration figure

upwork_ai_integration_growth.limits: A fast-growing category off a smaller base; growth rate is not market size

upwork_ai_skills_growth.limits: One platform, US marketplace, growth measured on earnings for skills explicitly referencing AI
upwork_ai_skills_growth.source: Upwork In-Demand Skills 2026 (published February 2026), from completed jobs with freelancer earnings, January to December 2025

upwork_non_ai_skills_growth.limits: Same platform and period; the comparison set is other in-demand skills, not all work
upwork_non_ai_skills_growth.source: Upwork In-Demand Skills 2026, same basis as above
